summary: Document formatting traversed tables hierarchically instead of preserving their original header order. In the selected test, inserting dependencies.newthing incorrectly moves [[example]] after the dependency subtables. The fix routes Display through the existing position-sorted serializer, preserving [[example]] before dependencies.opencl and placing the inserted table after its sibling. The detecting test in tests/test_edit.rs was updated by this fix. Both reversal regions occur exactly once in their respective Git versions. No builds or tests were run.
